extracted.name: Insalata Caprese
extracted.description: This insalata caprese salad features layers of ripe tomato slices, fresh mozzarella, and basil drizzled with olive oil and seasoned with salt and pepper.
ingredient_lines: 4 large ripe tomatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick
1 pound fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced 1/4 inch thick
instruction_lines: Alternate and overlap tomato slices, mozzarella cheese slices, and basil leaves on a large platter. Drizzle with olive oil. Season with sea salt and pepper.
